description: This file implements Windows-specific syslog functionality for logging, including opening logs and sending log messages via Windows Event Log APIs.

methods.name: void openlog(const char * ident,int logopt UNUSED,int facility UNUSED)
methods.description: Initializes the Windows Event Log handle using the provided identifier.

methods.name: void syslog(int priority,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats a log message, possibly replaces '%1' placeholders, and sends it to the Windows Event Log with an appropriate severity based on the priority.
